'''Andrzej Michał Kobos''' (29 September 1943 – 20 November 2024) was a Polish physicist and writer who authored, among others, six volumes of interviews with members of the [[Polish Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in the series ''Po drogach uczonych'' (''On the Paths of Scientists'').<ref>{{cite web |title = Zmarł dr Andrzej Kobos |accessdate = 2024-12-05 |url = https://www.strefa.se/2024/11/27/zmarl-dr-andrzej-kobos/ |publisher = strefa.se| date = 27 November 2024| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20241207021150/https://www.strefa.se/2024/11/27/zmarl-dr-andrzej-kobos/| archive-date = 2024-12-07}}</ref><ref name="archln">{{cite web| url = https://archiwum.nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=211602&_k=y6u921| title = Dr Andrzej Kobos| publisher = archiwum.nauka-polska.pl| accessdate = 2025-10-30}}</ref> He was a member of the Commission of the History of Science and the Commission of European Affairs of the Polish Academy of Arts and Sciences.<ref name="archln" />
